ND our Lord ſaid to him : Get thee in, thou and al thy
houſe into the atke ; tor I haue ſeen thee iuſt (a) in my
ſight in this genetation. 2. Ot al beaſts that are (v) cleane,
thou ſhalt take ſeauen and ſeauen, male and female: 3. but
of the beaſts that are vucleane two and two, male and te-
male. Yea and ot the foules alſo ot the ayre ſeauen and ſeauen, male and
temale: that ſeed mav be ſaued vpon the tace ot the whole earth. 4. For
yet a while, and atter ſeauen dayes I wil rayne vpon the earth tourtie
dayes and tourtie nights : and I wil cleane deitroy al ſubſtance that I
haue made, trom the tace of the earth. . Noe thertore did al things
which our Lord had commanded him. 6. And he was ſix hundred
yeares old , when the waters ot the floud flowed ouer the earth. 7. And
Noe entred and his ſonnes, his wife and the wiues ot his ſonnes with
him into the arke, becauſe of the waters ot the fioud. 8. Of beaſts alſo
the cleane and the vncleane, and ot toules , and of al that moueth vpon
the earth, 9. two and two went to Noe into the arke, male and female,
as our Lord had commanded Noe. 10. And after the ſeauen dayes were
paſſed, the waters of the floud flowed ouer the earth. 11. In the ſix huu-
then euer ſince dred veate of the lite of Noe, in the ſecond month, in the ſeauenteenth
day of the month, al the tountaines of the (c) great depth were broken
vp, and (d) the floud-gates of heauen were opened : 12. and the raine fel
vpon the earth tourtie dayes and tourtie nighis. 13. In the verie point ot
that day entred Noe, and Sem, and Cham, and Iapheth his ſonnes: and
his wite, and the three wiues of his ſonnes with them into the arke: 14.
they and euerie beait according to their kind, and al cattle in their kind,
and al that moueth vpon the earth according to their kind, and al foule
according to thcir kind, al birds, and al that fty 15. wert to Noe into
the arke, two and two ot al fleſh, wherin there was breath of life. 16.
And ſuch as entred in, male and temale ot al fleſh did enter in, as God
had commanded him: and our Lord ſhut him in on the out ſide. 19.
And the floud grew fourtie daies vpon the earth: and the waters increa-
ſed, and lifted vp the arke on high from the earth. 18. For they ouer-
flowed exceedingly ; and filled al on the face of the earth: moreouer the
arke fleeted vpon the waters. 19. And the waters preuailed out ot mea-
fure vpon the earth : and al the high mountaines vnder the whole
heauen were couered. 20, Fifteen cubits higher was the water aboue
